definitions.gloss: mechanism; structure; system; how something works
definitions.explanation: The way parts are arranged or connected to create a functioning whole.

FORMS:
{仕|し} (doing) + ⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧ (to assemble)

From the idea of how things are put together.
